pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
Deploy anywhere. Get paid on Telegram.

Here is what we're building next. Launching a coin on TeleMoney should be possible from wherever the conversation is happening, and the creator fees should always end up in the same place: a Telegram wallet, automatically.

Launching from X will work by mentioning a dedicated launch account in a post. Name the coin, add a ticker and an image, and tag the Telegram username that should receive the fees. The coin goes live on http://pump.fun and the launch account replies under your post with the contract address, the chart and a link to trade it. You'll also be able to launch from a reply, turning any post into a coin with that post as its story.

Fees can be sent to an X handle as well. If the person behind it has never used TeleMoney, their fees are held safely until they claim them. Claiming is simple: open our Telegram bot, link your X account to your Telegram, and everything that coin has earned is paid to you, along with everything it earns from then on.

The same options you have on the website will work from a post. A dev buy, buybacks that use part of the fees to buy the coin back, and splitting fees with a community will all be settings you can include when you launch.

X is the first step, not the last. The goal is that a coin can be launched from anywhere people talk: the website, the Telegram bot, the Mini App, an AI agent, a post on X, and every other platform after it. Whoever the coin is for, in any country, on any app, gets paid the same way: straight to Telegram, in their own wallet, without setting anything up.

We'll be building this over the weekend. Be Ready.
